libs.note: BH-9693. A BLOCK from another review lane (the >12h autopilot, review-prs, a box, run-build) on a moved head buys the merge conductor's own head-bound read before a head-not-reapproved park, at most MC_HNR_REREVIEW_MAX heads per PR. The blocked-resolver's re-review rung does not reuse such a BLOCK while the budget has room. Counted by the attempts line `hnrbuy <key> <head>`, written before the spend. Read by mc_hnr_max through lib_env_apply hnr-rereview.

knobs.note: Heads per PR on which another lane's BLOCK buys the conductor's own read instead of a park. 0 = every such BLOCK parks head-not-reapproved on sight (the behaviour before BH-9693). Past the budget the park names it: `re-review budget used (<used> of <max>)`. Read as ${MC_HNR_REREVIEW_MAX:-1}; not a number reads as 1.
